Today's release of macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate contains a short video that appears to demonstrate the Visual Intelligence feature running on Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods. Please watch the video below.

macOS 26.7 Contains a Demonstration of Camera-Equipped AirPods

MacRumors discovered a short video in today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC, in which a man wearing AirPods appears to ask Siri to note down the book he is looking at. Siri's voiceover says:

The camera itself is not visible in the video, and the earphones look very similar to the existing AirPods Pro. The most obvious difference is the stem, which appears slightly thicker.

Aaron Perris has also posted the same video on X:

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple may launch the camera-equipped AirPods, internally codenamed B790, as early as this year. MacRumors also found references to B790 in the macOS 26.7 RC this morning, including code for 'image stream'.

It is worth noting that these AirPods are reportedly not the same product as another camera-equipped model codenamed B798, which Bloomberg reported Apple has been developing and is expected to launch in 2027.

Given that Apple has decided to include this demonstration clip in the macOS 26.7 RC, this camera-equipped AirPods is highly likely to be officially unveiled at next month's iPhone launch event.

What do you think of this video? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
